matching_mechanism.field: V2Themes (GKG 2.1 column index 8; aka V2THEMES). Semicolon-delimited tokens, each optionally carrying a ',charOffset' suffix (e.g. 'TERROR,1843;ARMEDCONFLICT,55'). Use V2Themes (GKG 2.1), NOT the legacy coarser GKG 1.0 THEMES/GKGTHEMES field.
matching_mechanism.operator: REGEXP_CONTAINS(V2Themes, r'<family_re>') per category — RE2 syntax. REGEXP_CONTAINS does substring match; a token like TAX_TERROR_GROUP will also match TAX_TERROR_GROUP_ISLAMIC_STATE etc., which is the intended behaviour for prefix-family tokens.
matching_mechanism.owned_table_target: v3 builds gkg_gpr_flags_v2 alongside the immutable v1 gkg_gpr_flags. The v2 table adds matched_themes ARRAY<STRING> for future-proofing (see broad_capture_regex).

broad_capture_regex.purpose: Used in gpr_rollup_v2.sql to populate the matched_themes ARRAY<STRING> column. This column stores the raw GKG theme tokens each doc matched that are in the GPR-relevant superset. A future dictionary change can re-flag docs from this column (a cheap ~$0.30 owned-table scan) instead of re-scanning raw GKG (~$10). The superset is intentionally WIDE — it includes all category gkg_themes, all promoted tokens, plus close siblings in the military/nuclear/terror/conflict/rebel/extremism/proliferation/peacekeeping families. FALSE POSITIVES here are harmless (the column is a capture-net, not the scoring signal); FALSE NEGATIVES here are permanent (a missed family cannot be recovered without a raw rescan).
broad_capture_regex.note: This RE2 pattern is applied as REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r'...') over each SPLIT(V2Themes,';') token t in the matched_themes ARRAY extraction. The (?i) flag is included for safety but GKG themes are uppercase — this has no effect on production data. The WB_NNN_ prefixes match ALL subtokens under those World Bank nodes. TAX_WEAPONS and TAX_TERROR match all TAX_WEAPONS_*/TAX_TERROR_* subtokens. MIL_ matches all MIL_* tokens. SLFID_MILITARY matches SLFID_MILITARY_SPENDING, SLFID_MILITARY_READINESS, SLFID_MILITARY_BUILDUP etc. WB_509_NUCLEAR_ENERGY is included (civilian nuclear) so future analysts can distinguish civilian-nuclear from weapons-nuclear in matched_themes without another rescan. The exclude_tokens logic (WB_509_NUCLEAR_ENERGY as exclude for cat4) applies only to the category BOOL flags, NOT to matched_themes capture.

country_attribution.field: V2Locations (GKG 2.1 column index 10). Semicolon-delimited blocks, each '#'-delimited: type#fullname#countrycode#adm1#lat#long#featureID. Country code = block field index 2 (0-based), FIPS 10-4 2-letter.
country_attribution.extract: REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(V2Locations, r'#([A-Z]{2})#') then UNNEST; a doc attributes to every DISTINCT country it mentions.
country_attribution.prominence_gate: ANY-mention (no prominence gate) in P1, matching Iacoviello.
country_attribution.fips_to_iso3: Build map from a FIPS<->ISO3 reference table before the real run. Do NOT hand-type.

date_and_coverage.month_key: DATE (GKG 2.1 column index 1), YYYYMMDDHHMMSS. Month = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', PARSE_DATE(...))
date_and_coverage.prune_key: _PARTITIONTIME on gdelt-bq.gdeltv2.gkg_partitioned (TIMESTAMP, daily partitions). BOTH _PARTITIONTIME and DATE needed. ALL raw-GKG queries MUST filter on _PARTITIONTIME for cost pruning.

affine_invariance_note: Iacoviello's published GPRC = raw_share / mean(1985-2019) * 100 is a positive affine transform. Pearson and Spearman are invariant to a*x+b with a>0 — correlate against either the raw-share export or the mean-100 index with identical r. Levels remain incomparable; only within-country co-movement is comparable.

blended_proxy.name: QGI-GPR country proxy (8-category blend)
blended_proxy.formula: blended_share[country, month] = matched_docs / total_country_docs, where matched_docs = COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id) of docs attributed to that country/month whose V2Themes matches ANY of the 8 category families (a doc-level OR across g1..g8 = gpr_any), and total_country_docs = COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id) of ALL GKG docs attributed to that country that month (any theme / no theme).
blended_proxy.denominator_rule: total_country_docs = COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id), ANY theme — NEVER sum(category flags). Categories overlap; a single doc-OR per category (and a single gpr_any OR across all 8) keeps the blended share bounded in [0,1].
blended_proxy.headline_validation_target: GPRC_<ISO3> (country level, the r>0.9 PRODUCTION gate per build-plan §7) and global GPR.

threats_acts_split.note: Mirrors Iacoviello's GPRT (Threats) / GPRA (Acts) decomposition. Confirmed: sum(SHAREH_CAT_1..5) ~ GPRHT r=0.9889; sum(SHAREH_CAT_6..8) ~ GPRHA r=0.9994.
threats_acts_split.skew_expectation: v3 expected to improve on threat-side recall vs v2.1: cat3 gains 4 military/weapons tokens; cat8 gains 4 realized-terror act tokens; three previously-dead token names (WB_2462*, EXTREMIS/EXTREMISM, WB_2451*) now fire. The acts half (GPRA, r=0.999 in v1) is expected to remain strong. Primary validation units: threats-block (cats 1-5) vs GPRHT; acts-block (cats 6-8) vs GPRHA; blended vs GPRC. Do NOT report per-category r as the headline metric.

blended_proxy.metric_rule: State WHICH metric the reported r is on — levels-Pearson (trend-inflated DIAGNOSTIC) vs delta-Spearman (month-over-month change, the honest co-movement measure). The PoC PASS bar was 0.35 delta-Spearman; the v2/v3 PRODUCTION gate is r>0.9.

guards_carried_from_v1_v2: Headline metric is delta-Spearman on month-over-month change; levels-Pearson is a trend-inflated DIAGNOSTIC. State levels-vs-delta when reporting the r>0.9 gate; never silently switch.
Denominator is total_country_docs (COUNT DISTINCT doc_id, any theme), NEVER sum(category flags).
Dictionary FROZEN before P2 validation — no per-country token tuning on the test window (leakage guard).
share is bounded [0,1] (single doc-OR per category). Assert 0<=share<=1 per category and 0<=blended_share<=1; any violation is a counting bug.
t05 Protest / civil unrest stays OUT OF SCOPE.
The 7 PoC countries with no GPRC column (BGD/IRN/LBN/MMR/NGA/PAK/SDN) ship as 'QGI-GPR (uncalibrated)', NEVER 'GPR-validated'.
Confidence-first comms: this is a GDELT re-implementation, calibrated to Caldara-Iacoviello (2022). Never claim it IS the GPR.
TAX_MILITARY is permanently EXCLUDED from all category token lists. Only TAX_MILITARY_TITLE* exists in GKG (military ranks/job titles, 80M+ noise documents).
